C1_gate_granularity.ruling: Gates evaluate PER MANDATORY WORKLOAD, never per-track averaged. Basis: DECISION.md run budget ('five pairs per mandatory workload') and primary gate phrasing; no packet text supports averaging across cells.
C1_gate_granularity.mandatory_set_rule: Q00 must fix the mandatory set as the FULL frozen workload set actually exercised by the screened-in tracks (O3_ACCESS, O3_HOLDOUT, O3_FLOW, plus O2 as protected small cell) - the set may not be curated to exclude cells a candidate is expected to fail.
C1_gate_granularity.cell_failure_consequence: A cell failing the 1.1/paired-CI bar does not reject a zero-semantic-risk source change that decisively passes another frozen cell, but it FORBIDS claiming that cell; the final publication claim is scoped to passing cells and every per-cell result is published. In the packet's terminal vocabulary this is the improvement_only/scoped-claim space, never qualified_proxy across all cells.
C1_gate_granularity.user_override: campaign owner may override this reading any time before Q00; recorded now so qualification is not surprised

C2_cold_gate.ruling: The cold gate binds by default (maximum_cold_median_time_ratio 1.05). DECISION.md's own exception is sanctioned: 'Cold process median must not regress by more than 5% without an explicitly bounded warm-only qualification; warm-only means no blanket-default promotion claim.'

W00_precompile_reading.flag: reviewer boundary flag: does install-time precompile/warm of added kernels collide with the campaign's 'broad cache' prohibition?
W00_precompile_reading.reading: NO COLLISION. The prohibition (campaign contract) targets result memoization - caching computed outputs. Numba cache=True caches compiled machine code, not results; B0 itself already ships cache=True kernels (H04/H05 runs populated NUMBA_CACHE_DIR from baseline source). Install-time pre-population moves the identical JIT compile to install time, adding no numerical surface and no result cache. Compliant as a W00 build step.
W00_precompile_reading.condition: if any W00/Q00 proposal goes beyond compilation warm-up (caching or reusing computed results across runs), it is out of bounds and must not be baked in

v4_amendment_f1r_execution_entry.trigger: F1R canary admission refusal BEFORE any window opened: 0.80*available read 2608.4 MiB against the ruled 2620 MiB refusal threshold (11.6 MiB short), availability trending down (2625 -> 2608.4 -> 2578 MiB over minutes). Cause is ambient owner-side memory pressure (~80% of 16 GiB: browser helpers, mail, workspace app, security agent), not campaign consumption. Refusal entry UNCHARGED; heavy wall static 824.8 s / 14400 s; canary record retained with ok=false and screen roots untouched (they do not yet exist) - kept as evidence the ruled guard fired.
v4_amendment_f1r_execution_entry.ruling: EXECUTION-ENTRY TIGHTENING, coordinator discretion, no frozen value touched: F1R gate-eligible execution opens windows only while 0.80*available >= 2800 MiB, checked BEFORE the canary AND BEFORE EACH gate-eligible block, the read recorded in that block's record. Rationale: at the bar, available >= 3500 MiB, so the fixed 2600 MiB watchdog holds the ruled ~111 MiB trip margin over the ~2489 MiB sel1024 flow peak (P5 planning assumption restored), and a falling ambient trend cannot invite a mid-matrix admission refusal whose ruled consequence is void-restart-whole. The ruled per-window admission refusal (0.80*available < 2620 MiB -> refuse) remains the binding hard gate, byte-unchanged.
v4_amendment_f1r_execution_entry.watch_authorization: h05-profiler polls availability READ-ONLY while below the bar: no windows open, no lease charge, no writes outside its own diagnostics record. Proceeds autonomously under the standing GO once the bar holds (canary -> screen-roots check -> block 1 cold -> blocks 2-3 warm), reporting terms unchanged (canary in, per-block completion, immediate stop-and-report on byte delta / config mismatch / admission refusal). One cumulative-wait status report due to the coordinator if the wait exceeds ~1 h.

v4a_clarification_bar_binding_point.trigger: executor query before matrix fire: the frozen supervisor (bfc52e9a) has no per-block interlock - --stage run executes all 6 gate-eligible runs back-to-back, with the ruled per-window admission guard as the only mid-matrix gate. Enforcing the v4 2800 MiB bar literally 'before each block' would require a post-commit supervisor delta (pause/resume state machine) through the h04 freeze.
v4a_clarification_bar_binding_point.clarification: The v4 bar binds at every matrix ENTRY: the initial fire and any re-entry after a void/restart, enforced by the executor's read-only watch loop (same psutil call the admission guard uses). WITHIN a matrix, the sole binding mid-matrix protection is the frozen P5 per-window guard: refuse any window whose admission shows 0.80*available < 2620 MiB, voiding the matrix, which then restarts as a whole and re-enters only at the v4 bar. The v4 'read recorded per record' clause maps to each run's lease-log available_at_admission_bytes, verified post-hoc by the reviewer against these thresholds; a mid-matrix window opening above the ruled refusal threshold but below the v4 bar is CONFORMANT (the ruled ~111 MiB watchdog margin over the ~2489 MiB sel1024 peak is intact at any passing admission), not a ruling violation.
v4a_clarification_bar_binding_point.rationale: the per-window guard reads availability at the moment of Popen - strictly fresher than any pre-block read - using the same psutil quantity; an in-supervisor interlock would duplicate it with staler data, require editing frozen reviewer-verified bytes post-commit, and add a new pause/resume failure surface for headroom beyond what P5 requires. Entry-bar + per-window-guard + void-restart-whole already bounds the worst case: a mid-matrix ambient collapse costs a voided matrix and a bar-gated re-entry, never an under-protected window.
v4a_clarification_bar_binding_point.process_note: coordinator clarification of v4 within its owning record, filed BEFORE matrix fire; no screen_spec byte touched; reviewer ack requested for the verification-queue mapping (pre-block reads := per-run lease admission bytes)

rulings.re_pin_basis_general_rule: Every R screen isolates its own track's increment on the ADVANCING campaign line: the control arm is the advanced line MINUS that track's change, re-pinned and rebuilt per screen. An earlier screen's baseline wheel is never inherited verbatim once the line has advanced (mechanical origin of the confound: F1R inherited A1R's correct-for-A1R 71fd5615 wheel). 71fd5615 is RETAINED and labeled A1R-correct / F1R-wrong.
rulings.standing_audit_obligation: Arm identity is verified ARM TO ARM, never by single-file blob pins: full-tree git diff of the two pinned commits AND full package venv diff with wheel CONTENT authoritative (wheels carry no __pycache__) plus venv tree check with __pycache__ EXCLUDED and exclusion counts/reason recorded (interpreter-derived pyc legitimately differs across venvs; a full diff correctly STOPs on it - exercised by the retained blocked_1 build record, sha 5c989ca4ad34fe3ab5664c386abde448052f104391e1004d3333819fbff2a4c8). Cache-entry counts per run double as kernel-set identity receipts (repaired arms: b0=10 / b0p=12 / cand=12 files; b0p==cand confirms identical compiled sets).
rulings.quiet_window_sizing_precondition: Diagnostics-class SIZING runs (envelope/budget characterization) MUST record pre-fire preconditions IN the monitor record: psutil available >= 5368709120 B (5120 MiB) AND loadavg 1m < 8, poll read-only with no lease charge while waiting. Rationale: memory pressure reclaims resident pages during the compile transient, suppressing measured peaks far below true demand (2246.1 MiB observed vs ~3003 true) in a way both driver ru_maxrss and external tree sampling agree on - sizing from a suppressed peak guarantees mid-matrix watchdog kills. A second materially-low landing = STOP and report (systematic machine change, not variance). This PARTIALLY SUPERSEDES the v4 watch authorization for sizing runs only; GATE-ELIGIBLE runs keep the v4 entry bar + per-window guard unchanged (the v4a structure is untouched). Campaign unit convention is MiB/bytes, fraction-exact where non-integral, always paired with the byte count; frozen prose never states bare G-unit labels (coordinator's own decimal-GB mislabel corrected 2026-09-26).
rulings.reading_rule_replacement: The confounded-instrument cold accommodation (misses 1.05-1.15 read as compile cost) is WITHDRAWN with its instrument. Repaired-pair pre-registration: block-1 cold cand/b0 wall in [0.95, 1.05] = normal compile/variance bookkeeping (both arms compile the identical 6-kernel set); a cold miss (>1.05; gate value UNCHANGED) is an anomaly to investigate with C2 available per its own terms; warm blocks 2-3 are the thesis adjudicator (warm cand/b0 <= 1) and a warm miss takes the frozen failure path with NO reading-rule protection.
rulings.envelope_supersession: Rev-4 constants 2600/2620/2800 are superseded by the measured-peak chain, derived in ONE direction: governing cold sel1024 peak = max(b0p2_clean, cand 3003.25 MiB) -> budget = 1.10x peak -> per-window refusal = 0.80*avail < budget + margin -> entry bar = refusal + v4 spread at matrix ENTRY. Filled in screen_spec rev 5 from f1r_diag_coldpeak_b0p2 (mandatory quiet-window preconditions). Supervisor delta boundary: constants + derived literal strings + ARMS b0-entry re-point only, diffed against committed blob 3b0fee6d; h05 authors, coordinator commits hash-gated after the coordinator countermand window.
